summary: Message delivery reports waiting with the reason 'recipient stopped; queued message will be delivered when it starts' when the recipient's latest runtime observation is stopped, exited, or absent. Starting the recipient restores the ordinary queued reason; delivered and read receipts are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Uses existing delivery state and reason fields; no client-v0 wire fields or enum values change.

schema.detail: No table, index, or migration changes.
